verdict.rationale: No first-party docs in this pack explicitly describe a streaming API (e.g., run_stream, iter events) for tokens or tool-call events; the only relevant evidence is community reports noting that streaming works for some providers but not others, and that surfacing structured events/tool calls to a UI in real time requires significant custom glue (reconnection, history wiring) beyond what the framework provides out of the box. missing for 10: official streaming/iter API documentation, evidence of built-in event-to-UI wiring, independent hands-on confirmation of reliable cross-provider streaming.
